metrics.investment_case_interpretation: 折后净现金不能覆盖历史信号市值；公司 2023 扭亏且经营现金流转正，但核心业务利润很薄，分母经剔除投资/利息并折扣后较小，因此属于经营回本可算但超过 20 年的弱口径。

cash_breakdown.item: Cash and cash equivalents - situated in Chinese Mainland
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Mainland cash is disclosed as subject to remittance and foreign exchange control; no evidence of quick dividend path, so use PRC subsidiary cash haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash is economically fund asset but cross-border extraction is uncertain.

cash_breakdown.item: Cash and cash equivalents - other group cash
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Report does not split parent/offshore/operating subsidiaries; use group cash unknown ownership haircut, not full cash deduction.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially available to controller but may be held in operating subsidiaries and needed for live-game operations.

cash_breakdown.item: Current FVTPL treasury investments and others
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: FVTPL treasury/investment asset with limited product detail; default non-guaranteed/FVTPL haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Current financial asset may be saleable but value and timing are not cash-equivalent.

cash_breakdown.item: Listed equity securities within non-current FVTPL
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: HK/US listed securities are liquid but market price and execution risk remain.
cash_breakdown.reason: Non-operating listed securities can likely be sold.

cash_breakdown.item: Unquoted equity investments/private equity funds within non-current FVTPL
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Mostly unquoted internet/mobile/gaming equity and private equity funds; no clear exit path, prior investment impairments indicate risk.
cash_breakdown.reason: Non-operating investment asset, but controller cannot reliably extract near cash value.

cash_breakdown.item: Investment property - Chengdu office premise leased out
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Investment property is small, Mainland property sale/dividend route uncertain; default low investment-property haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Leased out office premise is not core game operation cash, but extraction is slow and uncertain.

cash_breakdown.item: Restricted deposits - CMB Fuzhou construction guarantee
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Pledged under a letter of guarantee for Fuzhou office construction contract.
cash_breakdown.reason: Restricted/pledged deposit cannot be treated as detachable cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserve roughly one month of cash operating needs for global game/app publishing, R&D, platform/channel settlement and cash-flow volatility.
cash_breakdown.reason: Removing it would impair ordinary operations.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Group operates through offshore, Singapore and Mainland entities; extraction may incur withholding tax, FX and distribution friction.
cash_breakdown.reason: Practical reserve before controller can use cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Annual report states no bank loans or other borrowings except lease liabilities.
Ordinary office leases are required for continuing operations and already reduce cash flow through lease payments; not mechanically deducted from detachable cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Lease burden is reflected in profit/cash-flow haircut rather than net cash deduction.

profit_quality.assessment: 2023 reported profit was only HK$73.053m after two loss years, while management-disclosed core-business profit was HK$17.596m after excluding investment gains/losses. Operating cash flow was HK$128.577m in 2023 after negative HK$98.239m in 2022; 2023 capex was HK$133.926m, mostly Fuzhou self-use office construction. Because cash assets are deducted in the numerator, bank interest and investment returns are not counted as sustainable operating cash profit. Main口径 uses HK$80m pre-haircut distributable cash profit and 0.40 profit haircut, producing HK$32m discounted sustainable distributable cash profit.
adjustments: Exclude HK$55.457m management-defined investment gain from reported net profit when judging core business.

Do not count HK$34.627m bank interest, HK$8.877m dividend income, HK$74.374m FVTPL fair value gains or HK$6.097m disposal gain in sustainable operating cash profit because related cash/investment principals are in the detachable asset pool.
Treat Fuzhou office construction capex as mainly growth/office property build, but keep only servers/computers plus software, about HK$10.788m, as minimum maintenance technology capex.

Apply heavy 0.40 cash-profit haircut because the last three-year profit record is volatile: 2021 profit HK$370.438m, 2022 loss HK$503.589m, 2023 profit HK$73.053m; 2022 OCF was negative and 2023 recovery is recent.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2023 OCF HK$128.577m versus profit HK$73.053m; 2022 OCF negative HK$98.239m versus loss HK$503.589m. Two-year cash support is improving but not yet stable.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Recent turnaround, investment/interest gains, volatile profits and only one positive OCF year after a loss year justify 0.40 rather than near-1.0.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Positive in 2023 but not proven across three years from current fact pack.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex approximated from servers/computers and software; large Fuzhou office construction is not treated as recurring maintenance.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2023 working capital consumed cash through funds receivable and trade/other receivable increases, partly offset by deferred revenue and payables.

limitations: 市值为输入粗筛的 2024-05-29 历史信号市值，不是 2026-07-22 当前市值。
现金未按上市母公司/离岸子公司/中国内地子公司逐项拆开，除中国内地现金披露外，其余集团现金使用保守折扣。
2023 年报只能直接支持 2022-2023 两年 OCF/capex；2021 现金流和 capex 未补充 prior annual report。
未上市 FVTPL/PE 基金投资缺少退出路径和估值流动性信息，折扣判断保守。
折后可持续可分配现金利润是专题估算，不是报表净利润。
